title: Homogeneous and inhomogeneous unit cohomology
statement: For every field K, the continuous homogeneous degree-two cohomology GaloisUnitsH2 K [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] is in bijection with GaloisUnitsTwoCocycleClasses K [def-sc-galois-units-two-cocycle-classes]. Both use the Krull topology on Gal(Ks/K) and the discrete natural module of separable-closure units. No etale sheaf cohomology occurs in this comparison.

proof.text: Use the canonical equivalence Field.galoisUnitsH2EquivTwoCocycleClasses from the upstream homogeneous cocycle descent module and package it in Nonempty. Its explicit cochain construction and quotient descent establish the comparison without an extra supplied cocycle equivalence.
